text:
Predicates:
SummerOlympicGames(x) ::: x is a summer Olympic game.
SportingEvent(x) ::: x is a sporting event.
LastSummerOlympicGames(x) ::: x is the last summer Olympic game.
InLocation(x, y) ::: x is in location y.
WonMostMedals(x, y) ::: x won the most medals in y.
UnitedStates(x) ::: x is the United States.
Premises:
∀x (SummerOlympicGames(x) → SportingEvent(x)) ::: The summer Olympic games is a sporting event.
∃x (LastSummerOlympicGames(x) ∧ InLocation(x, tokyo)) ::: The last summer Olympic games was in Tokyo.
∀x (UnitedStates(x) ∧ LastSummerOlympicGames(x) → WonMostMedals(x, x)) ::: The United States won the most medals in Tokyo.
Conclusion:
WonMostMedals(unitedStates, x) ::: The United States won the most medals in the last summer Olympic games.
